hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: Everything you need to know before joining the program.

items.q: Which types of sites are accepted?
items.a: Travel blogs, visa comparators, online agencies, content creators, student mobility sites, specialized forums. We don't accept pure cashback sites, unsolicited browser extensions, or GDPR-non-compliant sites.
On average 24 business hours. We review the site, the declared audience and market eligibility. You receive dashboard access by email once validated.
Validated sales (after the 14-day cooling-off period) are consolidated on the 1st of the following month. Payout on the 15th. SEPA, international wire or Wise, your choice.

Yes. That's one of the program's strengths: a single link automatically routes visitors to the page translated and priced for their country. You can also force a language/market for specific campaigns.

items.q: What is the attribution cookie window?
items.a: 90 days, versus 30 to 45 days with most competing programs. Classic last-click: if multiple partners are involved, the commission goes to the last referrer, in line with IAB standards.

items.q: Do you offer real deep links?
items.a: Yes, on every comparator page (travel insurance, working holiday, Schengen, ski, long stay, etc.) and on each offer detail page. This is a strong differentiator: several historic US programs have removed deep linking recently, we keep it because that's what drives conversion.

items.q: Can I integrate HelloSafe via Impact, Partnerize, Awin or Voluum?
items.a: Yes. We expose a standard S2S postback that plugs natively into Impact.com, Partnerize, Awin, Voluum, RedTrack and Everflow. We can also push conversions directly to your BI via webhook. Native HelloSafe tracking remains available if you want to avoid a third-party platform.

Yes on renewals: if a traveler subscribes to an annual contract and then renews it, you earn the commission again. That's what turns travel-insurance affiliation into cumulative revenue rather than a one-shot.
Yes. REST API with key-based auth, endpoints for quotes, offers, coverage and commissions. OpenAPI docs available from the dashboard. Conversion webhooks available.

items.q: Can I use the HelloSafe brand on my site?
items.a: Yes, within the partner brand kit (logos, badges, mentions) available in your dashboard. Bidding on the HelloSafe trademark on paid search is prohibited, standard contract clause.
